name: Neural Core — StudentIoT3
notes: Neural Core 1.1 visual overhaul: holographic command-deck styling and a denser animated neural topology.
Network visualization maps ESP32, Wi-Fi, temperature, humidity, Supabase, Realtime, REST fallback, and dashboard paths.
Animation follows actual device and connection state; it does not generate fake sensor readings.
Approved release detection runs every five minutes; applying an update still requires user approval.
Preserves the existing Supabase sensor_readings schema and ESP32-01 DHT11 contract.
